# MIKOL

> > MIKOL is a luxury marble accessories brand offering handcrafted tech cases, jewelry, and lifestyle products with premium natural stone design.

MIKOL specializes in high-end marble accessories for Apple devices and personal luxury goods, combining natural stone materials with minimalist design principles. The brand features exclusive collections including tech accessories, jewelry, and lifestyle products crafted from premium marbles like Nero Marquina and Carrara White.

## Key Topics

- Marble accessories
- Luxury goods
